The '''Intellex II''' was a second-generation [[Intellex]] [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] designed for use<ref name="Intellex" /> in the production model of the [[P2-series astromech droid]].<ref name="The History of R-Series Astromech Droids" /> Successor to a primitive version of the [[Intellex ship-configuration computer]]<ref name="The Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> used by [[Automata Galactica/Legends|Automata Galactica]] in P2 prototypes, it was developed as part of [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] efforts to bring the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] to market with minor modifications<ref name="The History of R-Series Astromech Droids" /> after receiving fairly positive feedback<ref name="P2 and R1 Astromech Droids">{{FactFile|21|AST 1-2|P2 and R1 Astromech Droids}}</ref> on those sold to the [[Old Republic shipping fleet]] on a trial basis. The Intellex II was created to facilitate the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] new database system, which was capable of handling new and different types of [[Starship/Legends|starships]], including [[Capital ship/Legends|capital]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. In addition, [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] included a primitive [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] program that could calculate a single jump if given enough [[Time/Legends|time]] and input.<ref name="The History of R-Series Astromech Droids" />
